가평에 메종드힐 키즈풀빌라 다녀왔어요👶🏻
할로윈 주간이라 이벤트가 있었는데🎃
친구들이랑 코스튬 입고 사진도 찍고
미국처럼 집집마다 다니면서
Trick or treat! 외치고 사탕도 받았어요!🍭

예쁜 키즈카페 온 것 같았어요

수심이 얕은 온수풀 수영장에서 물놀이도 하고
아기 위주의 주방템, 욕실템이 있어서
정말 편리하게 쉬다왔어요❤️
무엇보다 감성적인 인테리어가 사진도 잘 나와서

and I took pictures in costumes with my friends
and went door-to-door, just like in the US,
and trick-or-treating! We even got candy! 🍭
Hari was still little and just kept chasing us around,
but I think this will be an unforgettable memory for older kids. 👻

The atelier had a merry-go-round, a play kitchen, a slide, and more, so it felt like a cute kids' cafe. The accommodations were also full of toys, and we enjoyed splashing around in the shallow, heated pool. There were kitchen and bathroom items specifically designed for babies, so we had a really comfortable stay. ❤️
Above all, the emotional interior design turned out great in photos.
I want to go back with Hari again next time! ✨
